title: What Is Artificial Intelligence?
overview: Understand how AI is defined, the main approaches to building intelligent systems, and the key eras in the field's history.

title: Intelligent Agents and Environments
overview: Model an AI system as an agent that perceives an environment through sensors and acts through actuators to maximize a performance measure.

title: Problem Solving as Search
overview: Formulate tasks as search problems with states, actions, transition models, goal tests, and path costs.

title: Uninformed Search: BFS, DFS, UCS
overview: Study search strategies that use only the problem definition, without any estimate of distance to the goal.

title: Expert Systems and Rule-Based AI
overview: Learn how knowledge bases of if-then rules and an inference engine capture expert decision making.

title: Natural Language Processing Basics
overview: Cover how text is turned into numbers and how classic NLP tasks such as classification and tagging are approached.

title: Computer Vision Basics
overview: Explore how machines represent images as arrays and extract features for tasks like classification and detection.

title: Informed Search: Heuristics and A*
overview: Use heuristic estimates of remaining cost to guide search toward the goal efficiently.

title: Local Search and Optimization
overview: Optimize objective functions by moving through neighboring states, without tracking full paths.

title: Adversarial Search and Game Playing
overview: Choose moves in competitive two-player games by searching game trees under the assumption of an optimal opponent.

title: Constraint Satisfaction Problems
overview: Solve problems defined by variables, domains, and constraints using backtracking and constraint propagation.

title: Logic and Knowledge Representation
overview: Represent facts about the world in formal logic and derive new conclusions through inference.

title: Machine Learning in the AI Landscape
overview: See how learning from data fits within AI and how supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning differ.

title: AI Ethics, Fairness and Governance
overview: Understand the social impacts of AI, how bias arises, how fairness is measured, and how organizations govern AI use.

title: Explainable AI
overview: Learn why model decisions need explanation and survey methods for interpreting predictions.

title: Probabilistic Reasoning and Bayesian Networks
overview: Reason under uncertainty using probability, Bayes' rule, and graphical models that encode conditional independence.

title: Markov Decision Processes
overview: Model sequential decision making under uncertainty with states, actions, transition probabilities, and rewards.

title: Automated Planning
overview: Generate sequences of actions that achieve goals using symbolic descriptions of states and actions.

title: Reinforcement Learning Basics
overview: Learn how agents improve behavior from reward feedback when the environment model is unknown.

title: Large Language Models
overview: Understand how transformer-based language models are trained to predict tokens and how they are adapted for use.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
overview: Ground language model answers in external documents by retrieving relevant passages at query time.

title: AI Agents and Tool Use
overview: Build LLM-driven agents that plan, call external tools, observe results, and iterate toward a goal.

title: Multi-Agent Systems
overview: Study settings where several agents interact, cooperating, competing, or negotiating.

title: AI Safety and Alignment
overview: Examine how to make AI systems behave as intended and remain robust, even when objectives are hard to specify.
